fact: GUFE RCA states it officially launched its third operational branch of the one-stop company formalisation counter at Berberati on 2 February 2026, after Bangui and Bambari, offering company creation, modification and dissolution on the spot.
system: Guichet Unique de Formalisation des Entreprises (GUFE)

fact: Radio Lengo Songo reports the GUFE-RCA one-stop shop launched a website on 12 May 2026 with World Bank Icompete support, that the shop still works largely manually, and that the ministry says dematerialisation continues with UNDP support to allow remote company creation.

Oubangui Médias reports that on 24 October 2025 a Bangui workshop led by the Ministry of Commerce with UNDP validated the specification for digitising the manual Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier, to be accessed through the one-stop business formalities counter, which has a branch at Bambari with another planned at Berberati.
system: Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM)

fact: Bangui Inside reports that the Guichet unique de formalites des entreprises (GUFE), created by decree in 2007, centralises company creation, change and closure, with procedures only partly dematerialised and a first branch outside Bangui opened at Bambari on 17 September 2024.
